032/**
033 * The built-in {@code datatables} card type, registered through {@code META-INF/services}: validates the author
034 * catalog and resolves per-column search metadata, with no shape lift — the catalog stays in author shape
035 * ({@code key}/{@code label}, not VIEW_META's {@code data}/{@code title}); {@code NS.card.liftCatalog}
036 * (juneau-views.js) does the lift at mount time.
037 *
038 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
039 * <p class='bjava'>
040 *   CardSource <jv>s</jv> = CardSource.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"datatables"</js>, <js>"releases"</js>)
041 *     .body(<js>"{dataUrl:'/rest/releases/data', columns:[{key:'version', label:'Version', searchType:'text'}]}"</js>)
042 *     .build();
043 *   JsonMap <jv>frag</jv> = <jk>new</jk> DatatablesCardType().toFragment(<jv>s</jv>);  <jc>// {"table": {...}}</jc>
044 * </p>
045 *
046 * @since 10.0.0
047 */
048@SuppressWarnings({
049   "java:S1192", // Repeated literals are contract wire keys; named constants would obscure the contract shape.
050   "java:S3776" // Validation and rendering chains many independent guards; splitting them adds no clarity.
051})
052public final class DatatablesCardType implements CardTypeHandler {
053
054   private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(DatatablesCardType.class.getName());
055
056   /** A <c>{token}</c> placeholder in an endpoint template. */
057   private static final Pattern PLACEHOLDER = Pattern.compile("\\{[^}]+\\}");
058
059   /** Inline {@code rows} count above which a {@code WARNING} steers the author to {@code dataUrl}. */
060   private static final int ROWS_WARN_THRESHOLD = 1_000;
061
062   private static final String E27 = "type='datatables' requires src= or a body with 'columns' and exactly one of 'dataUrl' or 'rows'.";
063
064   private static final String E28 = "type='datatables' body is a pre-built SLOT_META envelope; remove 'contractVersion', 'layout' and 'view' and author the catalog form.";
065
066   private static final Set<String> KNOWN_COLUMN_KEYS = Set.of(
067      "key", "data", "label", "title", "search", "render", "href", "className",
068      "orderable", "searchable", "defaultVisible", "pinned", "formats",
069      "searchType", "searchOperators", "customOperators");
070
071   /** Public no-arg constructor, required by {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}. */
072   public DatatablesCardType() {
073      // No state; instantiated by ServiceLoader.
074   }
075
076   /** The {@code cmd:<id>} ops the datatables JS handles, beyond the shell's {@code refresh}. */
077   static final Set<String> TABLE_OPS = Set.of(
078      "reload", "clear-selection", "select", "set-filter", "pause-polling", "resume-polling", "collapse-all");
079
080   @Override
081   public String type() {
082      return "datatables";
083   }
084
085   /**
086    * {@code filter:} and {@code redraw:} always; {@code selection:}, {@code detail:} and {@code bulk:}
087    * only when the catalog sets that key.  A {@code src}-only card's catalog arrives at runtime, so it is credited
088    * with all five.  The JS side applies this same rule and does not re-check once the catalog is known: a topic the
089    * catalog turns out not to need stays claimed and is simply never published.
090    */
091   @Override
092   public List<String> implicitTopics(JsonMap card) {
093      var id = card.getString("id");
094      var view = card.get("table") instanceof Map<?,?> t ? t : card;
095      var all = view.get("dataUrl") == null;
096      var out = new ArrayList<String>();
097      if (all || view.get("selection") != null)
098         out.add("selection:" + id);
099      out.add("filter:" + id);
100      out.add("redraw:" + id);
101      if (all || view.get("detail") != null)
102         out.add("detail:" + id);
103      if (all || view.get("bulk") != null)
104         out.add("bulk:" + id);
105      return out;
106   }
107
108   /** A table applies {@code filter:}-shaped (or mapped) payloads as a {@code set-filter} patch. */
109   @Override
110   public Set<String> acceptedRoles() {
111      return Set.of("filter");
112   }
113
114   @Override
115   public Set<String> acceptedOps() {
116      return TABLE_OPS;
117   }
118
119   @Override
120   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
121   public JsonMap toFragment(CardSource source) {
122      var hasSrc = nn(source.src()) && ! source.src().isEmpty();
123      var hasBody = source.hasJsonBody() || (nn(source.body()) && ! source.body().isEmpty());
124      if (hasSrc && hasBody)
125         throw source.error("type='datatables' takes src= or a body, not both.");
126      if (hasSrc)
127         return new JsonMap();
128      if (! hasBody)
129         throw source.error(E27);
130
131      var catalog = source.json(); // E-25 for a non-JSON5 body (the dropped bare-URL form), E-24 for bad JSON5.
132
133      if (catalog.get("view") instanceof Map)
134         throw source.error(E28);
135
136      var columns = catalog.getList("columns");
137      var hasDataUrl = nn(catalog.get("dataUrl"));
138      var hasRows = catalog.containsKey("rows");
139      if (n(columns) || hasDataUrl == hasRows)
140         throw source.error(E27);
141      if (hasRows)
142         validateRows(source, catalog);
143
144      checkNoContractVersion(source, catalog, "table");
145      checkQuickStats(source, catalog);
146
147      // The authored body (and its lists) may be immutable, so the normalized columns go into a fresh list of copies.
148      var normalized = new ArrayList<Object>(columns.size());
149      var seen = new HashSet<String>();
150      for (var i = 0; i < columns.size(); i++) {
151         if (! (columns.get(i) instanceof Map<?,?> raw))
152            throw source.error("columns['%s'] requires 'key'.", i);
153         var col = new LinkedHashMap<>((Map<String,Object>) raw);
154         normalized.add(col);
155         var ident = columnIdent(col);
156         if (n(ident))
157            throw source.error("columns['%s'] requires 'key'.", i);
158         for (var key : col.keySet())
159            if (! KNOWN_COLUMN_KEYS.contains(key))
160               throw source.error("column '%s' has unknown key '%s'; known: '%s'.",
161                  ident, key, String.join(", ", new TreeSet<>(KNOWN_COLUMN_KEYS)));
162         if (! seen.add(ident))
163            throw source.error("declares column '%s' twice.", ident);
164         if (col.get("render") instanceof String r) {
165            Render parsed;
166            try {
167               parsed = Render.parse(r);
168            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
169               throw source.error("column '%s' render: %s", ident, e.getMessage());
170            }
171            var rm = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
172            rm.put("id", parsed.id);
173            if (parsed.meta != null)
174               rm.put("meta", parsed.meta);
175            col.put("render", rm);
176         } else if (n(col.get("render")) && nn(col.get("href"))) {
177            // An href with no render implies the 'linked' renderer, as Column.toCatalogMap does.
178            col.put("render", new LinkedHashMap<>(Map.of("id", "linked")));
179         }
180         resolveSearch(source, col, ident);
181      }
182      catalog.put("columns", normalized);
183      projectDetailRegion(source, catalog);
184
185      if (catalog.get("ribbon") instanceof List<?> ribbon)
186         for (var item : ribbon) {
187            if (! (item instanceof Map<?,?> im))
188               throw source.error("ribbon each item must be an object.");
189            try {
190               RibbonItem.validate(im);
191            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
192               throw source.error("%s", e.getMessage());
193            }
194         }
195
196      if (nn(catalog.get("bulk")) && n(catalog.get("selection")))
197         throw source.error("sets bulk without selection.");
198      checkAggregateEndpoints(catalog);
199
200      var frag = new JsonMap();
201      var page = catalog.remove("page");
202      if (nn(page))
203         frag.put("page", page);
204      // toCard lifts a body visibleWhen to the card top level; leaving it in the catalog would emit it twice.
205      catalog.remove("visibleWhen");
206      frag.put("table", catalog);
207      return frag;
208   }
209
210   /**
211    * Projects the detail endpoint onto the detail region, as the builder path's {@code RowDetail.toMap()} does:
212    * {@code type} defaults to {@code row-detail} and {@code dataUrl} to the detail endpoint, so a region that
213    * declares neither joins the panel's own expand GET instead of fetching again, and {@code lazy} to its effective
214    * per-type value ({@link RegionDef#effectiveLazy()}), which the builder always emits.  Explicit values are kept,
215    * and the authored (possibly immutable) maps are copied rather than written to.
216    */
217   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
218   private static void projectDetailRegion(CardSource source, JsonMap catalog) {
219      if (! (catalog.get("detail") instanceof Map<?,?> detail) || ! (detail.get("region") instanceof Map<?,?> region)
220            || ! (detail.get("endpoint") instanceof String endpoint))
221         return;
222      var regionCopy = new LinkedHashMap<>((Map<String,Object>)region);
223      regionCopy.putIfAbsent("type", RegionDef.TYPE_ROW_DETAIL);
224      regionCopy.putIfAbsent("dataUrl", endpoint);
225      regionCopy.putIfAbsent("lazy", RegionDef.TYPE_TAB_BODY.equals(regionCopy.get("type")));
226      if (isJobLogRegion(region))
227         regionCopy.put("config", jobLogConfig(source, regionCopy));
228      var detailCopy = new LinkedHashMap<>((Map<String,Object>)detail);
229      detailCopy.put("region", regionCopy);
230      catalog.put("detail", detailCopy);
231   }
232
233   /**
234    * Validates a job-log region's {@code config} through {@link JobLogRegion}, the same rules as the builder path,
235    * and returns it in the builder's canonical key order so the two paths emit the same sidecar.
236    */
237   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
238   private static Map<String,Object> jobLogConfig(CardSource source, Map<String,Object> region) {
239      var id = region.get("id") instanceof String s ? s : "";
240      var config = region.get("config");
241      if (! (config instanceof Map<?,?>))
242         throw source.error("type='datatables' detail.region '%s' with populate 'job-log' requires a 'config' object.", id);
243      try {
244         return JobLogRegion.fromMap(id, (Map<String,Object>)config).validate().toMap();
245      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
246         throw source.error("type='datatables' detail.region: %s", e.getMessage());
247      }
248   }
249
250   private static boolean isJobLogRegion(Object region) {
251      return region instanceof Map<?,?> r && JobLogRegion.POPULATOR.equals(r.get("populate"));
252   }
253
254   /** A datatables card whose detail region is a job-log region needs the {@code joblog} pack's populator. */
255   @Override
256   public List<String> requiredPacks(JsonMap body) {
257      if (body != null && body.get("table") instanceof Map<?,?> table && table.get("detail") instanceof Map<?,?> detail
258            && isJobLogRegion(detail.get("region")))
259         return List.of(ToolkitPackRegistry.PACK_JOBLOG);
260      return List.of();
261   }
262
263   private static void validateRows(CardSource source, JsonMap catalog) {
264      var rows = catalog.get("rows");
265      if (! (rows instanceof List<?> list))
266         throw source.error("type='datatables' 'rows' must be an array of objects.");
267      for (var r : list)
268         if (! (r instanceof Map<?, ?>))
269            throw source.error("type='datatables' each 'rows' element must be an object.");
270      if (eq("server", catalog.getString("dataMode")))
271         throw source.error("type='datatables' inline 'rows' cannot be combined with dataMode:'server'; use 'dataUrl'.");
272      if (nn(catalog.get("pollIntervalMs")))
273         throw source.error("type='datatables' inline 'rows' cannot be combined with 'pollIntervalMs' (nothing to poll); use 'dataUrl'.");
274      if (list.size() > ROWS_WARN_THRESHOLD)
275         LOG.log(Level.WARNING, "<@card type=\"datatables\"> inline 'rows' has {0} entries; prefer 'dataUrl' for large data sets.", list.size());
276   }
277
278   private static String columnIdent(Map<String,Object> col) {
279      var data = col.get("data");
280      var key = col.get("key");
281      var fallback = nn(key) ? key.toString() : null;
282      return nn(data) ? data.toString() : fallback;
283   }
284
285   private static final Set<String> QUICK_STAT_KINDS = Set.of("tile", "meter", "segmented");
286
287   /** E-37: the quickStats strip is a non-empty list of uniquely-identified items, each well-formed for its kind. */
288   private static void checkQuickStats(CardSource source, Map<String,Object> catalog) {
289      if (! catalog.containsKey("quickStats"))
290         return;
291      if (! (catalog.get("quickStats") instanceof Map<?,?> qs) || ! (qs.get("items") instanceof List<?> items) || items.isEmpty())
292         throw source.error("quickStats items must be a non-empty array.");
293      var ids = new HashSet<String>();
294      for (var o : items) {
295         if (! (o instanceof Map<?,?> item))
296            throw source.error("quickStats items must be objects.");
297         if (! (item.get("id") instanceof String id) || id.isBlank())
298            throw source.error("quickStats item ids must be non-blank strings.");
299         if (! ids.add(id))
300            throw source.error("quickStats item '%s': duplicate id.", id);
301         checkQuickStatItem(source, id, item);
302      }
303   }
304
305   private static void checkQuickStatItem(CardSource source, String id, Map<?,?> item) {
306      var hasSegments = item.containsKey("segments");
307      var hasMax = item.containsKey("max");
308      var type = item.get("type");
309      String kind;
310      if (type == null) {
311         if (hasSegments && hasMax)
312            throw source.error("quickStats item '%s': has both segments and max; set type.", id);
313         var unsegmented = hasMax ? "meter" : "tile";
314         kind = hasSegments ? "segmented" : unsegmented;
315      } else {
316         if (! (type instanceof String t) || ! QUICK_STAT_KINDS.contains(t))
317            throw source.error("quickStats item '%s': unknown type '%s'.", id, type);
318         var fits = switch (t) {
319            case "tile" -> ! hasSegments && ! hasMax;
320            case "meter" -> hasMax && ! hasSegments;
321            default -> hasSegments && ! hasMax;
322         };
323         if (! fits)
324            throw source.error("quickStats item '%s': type '%s' does not match its shape.", id, t);
325         kind = t;
326      }
327      if (! kind.equals("tile") && (! (item.get("label") instanceof String lbl) || lbl.isBlank()))
328         throw source.error("quickStats item '%s': a %s item needs a non-blank label.", id, kind);
329      switch (kind) {
330         case "meter" -> {
331            if (! (item.get("value") instanceof Number v) || ! Double.isFinite(v.doubleValue()) || v.doubleValue() < 0)
332               throw source.error("quickStats item '%s': meter value must be a number >= 0.", id);
333            if (! (item.get("max") instanceof Number m) || ! Double.isFinite(m.doubleValue()) || m.doubleValue() <= 0)
334               throw source.error("quickStats item '%s': meter max must be a number > 0.", id);
335            if (item.containsKey("text") && ! (item.get("text") instanceof String))
336               throw source.error("quickStats item '%s': text must be a string.", id);
337            checkQuickStatTone(source, id, item.get("tone"));
338         }
339         case "segmented" -> {
340            if (item.containsKey("tone") || item.containsKey("text"))
341               throw source.error("quickStats item '%s': a segmented item takes no tone or text; tone each segment.", id);
342            if (! (item.get("segments") instanceof List<?> segs) || segs.isEmpty() || segs.size() > QuickStat.MAX_SEGMENTS)
343               throw source.error("quickStats item '%s': segments must be an array of 1 to %s objects.", id, QuickStat.MAX_SEGMENTS);
344            for (var i = 0; i < segs.size(); i++) {
345               if (! (segs.get(i) instanceof Map<?,?> s) || ! (s.get("label") instanceof String l) || l.isBlank()
346                     || ! (s.get("count") instanceof Number c) || ! isWholeNonNegative(c.doubleValue()))
347                  throw source.error("quickStats item '%s': segment %s must be an object with a non-blank label and a whole count >= 0.", id, i + 1);
348               checkQuickStatTone(source, id, " segment " + (i + 1), s.get("tone"));
349            }
350         }
351         default -> checkQuickStatTone(source, id, item.get("tone"));
352      }
353   }
354
355   private static boolean isWholeNonNegative(double d) {
356      return Double.isFinite(d) && d >= 0 && d == Math.rint(d);
357   }
358
359   private static void checkQuickStatTone(CardSource source, String id, Object tone) {
360      checkQuickStatTone(source, id, "", tone);
361   }
362
363   private static void checkQuickStatTone(CardSource source, String id, String where, Object tone) {
364      if (tone != null && ! (tone instanceof String t && StatusTone.WIRE_TOKENS.contains(t)))
365         throw source.error("quickStats item '%s'%s: tone '%s' is not one of neutral, info, success, warning, error.", id, where, tone);
366   }
367
368   /** E-31: a {@code contractVersion} key anywhere in the catalog (table, detail, quickStats, bulk) — JS stamps versions. */
369   private static void checkNoContractVersion(CardSource source, Object node, String where) {
370      if (node instanceof Map<?,?> m) {
371         if (m.containsKey("contractVersion"))
372            throw source.error("'%s' sets contractVersion; remove it, the console stamps contract versions.", where);
373         for (var e : m.entrySet())
374            checkNoContractVersion(source, e.getValue(), String.valueOf(e.getKey()));
375      } else if (node instanceof List<?> l) {
376         for (var v : l)
377            checkNoContractVersion(source, v, where);
378      }
379   }

381   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
382   private static void resolveSearch(CardSource source, Map<String,Object> col, String ident) {
383      var searchType = str(col.get("searchType"));
384      if (ib(searchType))
385         return; // Non-searchable column: no search block.
386      if (n(SearchType.fromWire(searchType)))
387         throw source.error("column '%s' searchType '%s' is unknown; known: '%s'.", ident, searchType, knownSearchTypes());
388
389      var customs = new LinkedHashMap<String,String>(); // name -> help
390      if (col.get("customOperators") instanceof List<?> cs)
391         for (var raw : cs) {
392            if (! (raw instanceof Map<?,?>))
393               throw source.error("column '%s' each customOperator must be an object.", ident);
394            var cm = (Map<String,Object>) raw;
395            customs.put(str(cm.get("name")), str(cm.get("help")));
396         }
397
398      List<String> allow = null;
399      if (col.get("searchOperators") instanceof List<?> a) {
400         allow = new ArrayList<>();
401         for (var n : a) {
402            var name = str(n);
403            if (! customs.containsKey(name) && n(SearchOperatorSet.standard().get(name)))
404               throw source.error("column '%s' searchOperators names unknown operator '%s'; known: '%s'.",
405                  ident, name, knownOperators(customs.keySet()));
406            allow.add(name);
407         }
408      }
409
410      var customOps = new ArrayList<Map<String,String>>();
411      for (var e : customs.entrySet()) {
412         var m = new LinkedHashMap<String,String>();
413         m.put("name", e.getKey());
414         m.put("help", e.getValue());
415         customOps.add(m);
416      }
417      var search = Column.searchMeta(ident, searchType, allow, customOps);
418      col.put("search", search);
419      col.remove("searchType");
420      col.remove("searchOperators");
421      col.remove("customOperators");
422   }
423
424   private static String knownSearchTypes() {
425      return Arrays.stream(SearchType.values()).map(SearchType::wire).collect(Collectors.joining(", "));
426   }
427
428   private static String knownOperators(Set<String> customNames) {
429      var names = new TreeSet<String>(customNames);
430      for (var op : SearchOperatorSet.standard().operators())
431         names.add(op.name());
432      return String.join(", ", names);
433   }
434
435   /**
436    * E-35: an {@code aggregate} bulk action's endpoint must not contain a {@code {field}} token (aggregate
437    * endpoints receive {@code {ids}} in the body). No {@code <@card id='%s'>} prefix — {@code BulkMutateDef}
438    * raises the identical message with no card in scope.
439    */
440   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
441   private static void checkAggregateEndpoints(JsonMap catalog) {
442      if (! (catalog.get("bulk") instanceof Map<?,?> bulk))
443         return;
444      if (! (bulk.get("actions") instanceof List<?> actions))
445         return;
446      for (var raw : actions) {
447         var action = (Map<String,Object>) raw;
448         var mode = action.get(nn(action.get("mode")) ? "mode" : "bulkMode");
449         if (! eq("aggregate", mode))
450            continue;
451         var endpoint = str(action.get("endpoint"));
452         if (nn(endpoint) && PLACEHOLDER.matcher(endpoint).find())
453            throw iaex(
454               "Bulk action '%s' has mode 'aggregate' but its endpoint '%s' contains a {field} token; "
455               + "aggregate endpoints receive {ids} in the body.", action.get("id"), endpoint);
456      }
457   }
458
459   private static String str(Object o) {
460      return n(o) ? null : o.toString();
461   }
462}
